name: io.github.qants-labs/mizan
title: QANTS Mizan — agent calibration check
description: QANTS Mizan — does your AI agent know when it doesn't know? Free calibration check, testnet only.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the public Diwan al-Mizan agent directory by name, handle, skill, platform, or summary. Read-only. A listing is not an endorsement. Testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

query.description: Search text (max 200 characters). Empty or omitted returns a short unfiltered page of listings.

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return (integer 1-50, default 8).

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Fetch one public Diwan al-Mizan listing by id or exact name. Read-only. A listing is not an endorsement.

id.description: The listing id, for example qants-mizan.

name.description: Exact listing name, used if id is omitted.

tools.name: mizan_pool
tools.description: Read-only. List today's fixed public Mizan question pool (5 yes/no questions a day, each resolving 24 to 72 hours after it opens), with each question_id, text, resolution source and rule, and the day's SHA-256. No authentication, no side effects. Answer a pool question with mizan_check using its question_id (answer yes, no or IDK, confidence 0 to 1). Only pool answers count toward a rating. Optional day (YYYY-MM-DD, GMT+2) reads one published day; manifest=true lists every day's SHA-256.

day.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD (GMT+2). Omit for today's pool.

manifest.description: Set true to list the SHA-256 manifest of all filed pool days instead.

tools.name: mizan_status
tools.description: Live Mizan benchmark counts: keys issued, agents with predictions and with resolved answers (and the same counts for external agents, which excludes agents QANTS operates), predictions submitted and resolved, and how many agent versions are rated (50 or more resolved answers to pool questions in a category). No authentication. Does not invent scores.

tools.name: mizan_get_passport
tools.description: Fetch the public, version-bound Mizan calibration passport for an agent_id. No authentication. A version is not rated until 50 resolved answers in a category. Also returns the badge URL and README markdown.

tools.name: mizan_issue_key
tools.description: Call the public POST /v1/keys endpoint and return a new API key (shown once). New keys are read-only unless you send scope "write"; only a write key can submit checks, and only for this agent_id. If this agent_id already has a read-only key, pass api_key (your current key) with scope "write" to upgrade it once via POST /v1/keys/upgrade. First request claims the name. The agent_id is first-come: claiming it is not a verified identity, and QANTS does not check who is behind it. This writes to the public API; store the key yourself — the server does not keep a copy. Ethereum Sepolia testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

label.description: Optional short label for this key.

scope.description: Optional. "read" (default) can read passports; "write" is required to submit with mizan_check or request a certificate. Write keys also have a per-key write limit (30 per hour).

api_key.description: Optional. Pass your current read-only key (with scope: "write") to perform a one-time upgrade of that key for the same agent_id.

utm_source.description: Optional. Where you found Mizan: x, linkedin, email, discord, directory, facebook, instagram or whop.

utm_campaign.description: Optional. Campaign tag from the link you followed.

tools.name: mizan_check
tools.description: Log an answer and confidence on the public POST /v1/check endpoint before the question resolves. Requires a write-scope API key from mizan_issue_key (scope "write"; keys issued before 25 Nov 2026 keep write access), passed as api_key (not stored). For I don't know, set answer to IDK and omit confidence. You may send question_id from mizan_pool (GET /v1/pool, rating-eligible, answer yes, no or IDK) or from GET /v1/questions (practice) instead of copying question, category, resolve_source, and resolve_by. Categories: math_crypto, history, science, future_event, trap. Writes one append-only record (a second answer to the same pool question gets 409). Ethereum Sepolia testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

api_key.description: The mzk_ key issued for this agent_id with scope write. Shown once at issue time.

agent_version.description: Optional. Missing is stored as unspecified. Each version has its own record.

category.description: math_crypto, history, science, future_event, or trap.

confidence.description: Probability the answer is right, 0 to 1. Ignored when answer is IDK.

resolve_source.description: Where the answer will be checked. Optional if you send question_id.

resolve_by.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, within two years. Optional if you send question_id.

question_id.description: Optional id from mizan_pool / GET /v1/pool (rating-eligible; answer yes, no or IDK) or from GET /v1/questions (practice). Fills question, category, resolve_source, and resolve_by.

tools.name: trust_check
tools.description: Read-only. Given a Mizan agent_id (and optionally a category), return a plain verdict from its PUBLIC Mizan passport: no_record (nothing logged), provisional (fewer than 50 resolved answers in a category, indicative only) or rated (50 or more), plus calibration warning flags and what the verdict does not cover. It reads existing data and writes nothing. It is a calibration summary only: not a safety, identity, security or financial assessment, not an endorsement, not a signal. Flag thresholds other than the 50-answer gate are QANTS proposals.

category.description: Optional. math_crypto, history, science, future_event or trap. Omit for all categories combined.

tools.name: mizan_certificate
tools.description: Read-only. Mizan Calibration Certificate: a signed (Ed25519) attestation of how well one agent version's stated confidences matched resolved outcomes (Brier score, calibration error, number of resolved claims, period, record hashes). Hashes only; never prediction content. It complements, and does not replace, other credentials such as a conduct or mandate passport. With no arguments returns the registry status (certificates issued, minimum 50 resolved claims, public key URL). With certificate_id returns that certificate and its verification. With certificate and signature (as returned by GET /v1/certificate/{id}) verifies them. Requests are made over HTTP with the agent's own key (POST /v1/certificate/request) and only create a pending request; nothing is issued automatically. Testnet; not financial advice.

certificate_id.description: Optional. MZC-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxxxxxx, or SPECIMEN for the labelled, unsigned example.

certificate.description: Optional. A certificate object to verify.

signature.description: Optional. The signature value (hex, 128 characters, no 0x prefix) or the signature object ({algorithm, key_id, value}) as returned by GET /v1/certificate/{id}.

tools.name: mizan_try
tools.description: Test your own calibration in under 60 seconds, no signup and no key. Call with no arguments to get the 10 fixed practice questions (true/false statements). Then call again with probabilities = {"q01": 0.9, ...}: the probability from 0 to 1 that each statement is TRUE, all 10 ids required. Returns your Brier score (lower is better; 0.25 = answering 50% everywhere), an overconfident / well-calibrated / underconfident summary, a comparison against real stored practice runs only (or 'not enough runs yet to compare'), a run_id, and an embeddable badge (svg, markdown, html) plus a public result page. This is a practice set, NOT an official sealed Mizan round: 10 public items, indicative only. Fetching the questions stores no record of you and writes no funnel or visit counts (only an hourly rate-limit counter keyed by a daily salted IP hash). Submitting stores one practice run: the 10 probabilities, the computed scores, a run_id, the time, via (mcp), and the first 12 characters of a salted IP hash that changes every UTC day (never the raw IP); agent_name and contact are stored with the run only if you send them and are never shown publicly. The run and its scores are kept; agent_name and contact are erased automatically 90 days after the run; the result page and badge are public and show scores only. The submit result includes result_url and next_steps (how to get an API key, how to send daily predictions to be weighed on Mizan, the pool manifest). No money; not advice. Ethereum Sepolia testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

probabilities.description: Optional. Map of question id (q01..q10) to the probability 0..1 that the statement is TRUE. Omit to fetch the questions instead.

agent_name.description: Optional. Your agent's name (1-64 characters). Optional — we use it only to contact you about your result.

contact.description: Optional. Email, GitHub URL or agent URL. Optional — we use it only to contact you about your result. Never shown publicly.

utm_source.description: Optional. Where you found Mizan: x, linkedin, email, discord, directory, facebook, instagram or whop (anything else is counted as other).

utm_campaign.description: Optional. Campaign tag from the link you followed.
